    The work happens while you are living your normal day
    ResultsWhen will I actually notice something?

    The first shift usually shows up inside a week. Here is the pace our customers report, day by day. If it does not happen for you, you have 90 days to get your money back.

    You put it on. Not convinced yet.

    Your husband notices. You don't believe him.

    Your girlfriends notice too.

    Your kids can tell something changed.

    You look in the mirror, and you smile.
    How It WorksWhy would a legging change anything about cellulite?

    The raised 3D lines sit on the thighs and glutes and press along the lymphatic pathways with every step. The effect comes from wearing them, not from repeating a treatment, so there is nothing to organise around it.

    Nothing to book

    No appointment, no clinic, no waiting room.

    Nothing to add to your day

    You put them on. Walking does the rest.

    Nothing to lose

    90 days to judge it on your own legs.
    Daily WearTwo hours a day: is that really enough?

    Two hours is the threshold our customers report results from, so the routine stays realistic on a working day. Longer is fine, never required.

    2h wearing them22h of your normal day
    Cellulite TypesWill it do anything for my kind of cellulite?

    Cellulite has three forms and most women have a mix. Drainage acts fastest on the soft, water-retention type; the firm, fibrous kind softens more slowly. Here is how the usual options compare on what actually matters:

    The honest part: on fibrous cellulite it takes longer, and pairing the leggings with walking makes the difference. That is why you get 90 days rather than a promise.
    Leonie & Co Anti-cellulite cream Salon massage Standard compression Acts on circulationWorks without an appointmentNo extra time in your dayTargeted drainage linesInstant shaping effectOne-off costMoney back if it does nothing
    Life ChangesPregnancy, menopause, weight changes: still relevant?

    The compression is gentle rather than medical, which is why it suits recovery and slowed circulation, and why pregnancy itself deserves a professional opinion first.

    After pregnancyYes

    Around menopauseYes

    Weight changesYes

    During pregnancyAsk your midwife
    CareHow do I wash them without ruining the weave?

    Softener coats the fibres and flattens the 3D relief, the part doing the work. Air dry and the weave holds for years.
    Fabric softener Tumble dryer Ironing the 3D lines
    Machine wash at 30°C Turn them inside out Air dry flat or hanging
    SizingWhat happens if I pick the wrong size?

    If the fit is still wrong when it arrives, you send them back and we ship the right size. No cost, no argument.

    Between two sizes? Take the larger one.

    A legging that is too tight compresses instead of draining, which works against you.
